insights.headline: Turnover -2,538 kEUR (-10.2%) YOY despite Discount % TO moving -312 bps.
insights.evidence: Brand OLIVE -2,717 kEUR; Channel DT -3,307 kEUR; Product PACK 1.1KG -3,124 kEUR
insights.impact_basis: Current-period Turnover variance versus the governed comparison period.
insights.recommended_action: Build a focused recovery plan around the largest Brand, Channel and Product declines; validate distribution, availability and customer sell-in before changing discount terms.
insights.caveat: Dimension cuts explain the same total variance and must not be added together.

insights.headline: DT combines Turnover -3,307 kEUR with Discount % TO +291 bps.
insights.evidence: Current Discount % TO 35.9% vs 33.0%; diagnostic recovery proxy +451 kEUR.
insights.impact_basis: Return to prior-period Discount % TO at current Turnover; diagnostic proxy only.
insights.recommended_action: Review customer and product exceptions in this segment, confirm contract and promotion mechanics, then assign only validated recovery items.
insights.caveat: The value is not a target, forecast or causal promotion ROI estimate.

insights.headline: PBO +5,198 kEUR while Gross Profit -10,302 kEUR; Marketing spend -15,500 kEUR.
insights.evidence: Gross Margin moved -35 bps and PBO margin +393 bps. SKY internal growth -7.6% vs market +23.8%.
insights.impact_basis: Annual P&L variance; Market comparison is contextual and period-misaligned.
insights.recommended_action: Separate structural productivity from deferred growth investment and require Brand-level evidence before extending marketing reductions where sell-in trails the Market.
insights.caveat: P&L is annual and Market data is MAT; neither should be allocated below its supported grain.
